info.title: bria/structured-instruction
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "bria/structured-instruction", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Request body for Bria Structured Instruction Generate API

images.description: The source image to be edited. Publicly available URL or Base64-encoded. Must contain exactly one item.

instruction.description: Required. Text-based edit instruction (e.g., "make the sky blue", "add a cat").

ip_signal.description: If true, returns a warning for potential IP content in the instruction.

mask.description: Optional mask image URL or Base64-encoded. Black areas will be preserved, white areas will be edited.

prompt_content_moderation.description: If true, returns 422 on instruction moderation failure.

seed.description: Seed for deterministic generation. If omitted, a random seed is used.

visual_input_content_moderation.description: If true, returns 422 on images or mask moderation failure.

200.description: OK - the provider's native result document, returned unchanged. Comfy has not described this model's output yet, so neither its shape nor its media type is narrowed here; the provider's own documentation is authoritative.

schema.description: Comfy has not described this model's result document yet. Router returns the provider's native output unchanged, so the provider's own documentation is authoritative for the response shape.
